name: SikaBond®-105 ContactFix
summary: SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is a premium contact adhesive that has been formulated to meet varied needs for lamination and fabrication. SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is fast drying and forms a strong bond that is heat and water resistant.
metaDescription: SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is a premium contact adhesive that has been formulated to meet varied needs for lamination and fabrication. SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is fast drying and forms a strong bond that is heat and water resistant.
usage: SikaBond®-105 ContactFix has a very broad adhesion range and forms a strong and lasting bond. Suitable substrates are timber, rubber sheets, plastic laminates, fabric, cloth backed and polyester backed vinyl, MDF, particleboard, concrete, glass and metal sheets. In the production of transport vehicles SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is suitable for room temperature contact bonding of different covering materials e.g. PUR foams, textiles, adjoining steps, wheel arches, seat brackets and side walls, especially for covering materials with high spring-back forces, cover trims and edging profiles. SikaBond®-105 ContactFix is also suitable for auto upholstery and furniture upholstery. Test with actual substrates and conditions to ensure adhesion and material compatibility.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions and out of direct sunlight at temperatures between +5°C and +25°C. Always refer to packaging. Refer to the current Safety Data Sheet for information on safe handling and storage

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: The adhesion surfaces must be sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, poorly bonded coatings, loose and friable materials.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Uncured SikaBond®-105 ContactFix may be removed from tools and equipment with Sika® Remover-208, Sika® Colma Cleaner or other suitable solvent. Once cured, hardened material can only be removed mechanically. For cleaning skin use Sika® Cleaner-350H.
